baseline_models.mechanism: The passive recital is an ordered approach to the hearer; his utterance then follows the reciting voice as a counter-voice that redirects the sequence.

activation_trace.role: Literal sequential following makes the recited units an ordered approach rather than an undifferentiated message.
A responding voice that follows another supplies the antiphonal image for his immediate counter-utterance.
Audibly produced speech locates the decisive action in a voiced response rather than in silent doubt.

changed_reading.before: Signs are recited and the hearer then states an opinion about them.
changed_reading.after: Ordered signs arrive voice after voice, and the hearer inserts his own following voice as a counter-recitation that diverts their sequence.

baseline_models.mechanism: The response performs a category switch: presented signs are verbally redefined either as merely inherited written rows or as baseless narratives. The written-row and false-tale readings remain co-present rather than being collapsed.

activation_trace.role: A conspicuous identifying mark supplies the evidentiary category that the reply seeks to replace.
Speech used to delimit or define makes the utterance an act of classification, not a neutral report.
Arranged written rows keep alive the reading that the speaker demotes the signs to old textual material.
Fabricated or disorderly tales keep alive the sharper accusation that the signs lack a true source.
Temporal or ranked precedence supplies the relegation of the material to an earlier human horizon.

changed_reading.before: He dismisses the recitation as ancient legends.
changed_reading.after: He actively converts signs into a rival genre: only old written rows, baseless inherited stories, or both at once.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening measure-and-loss sequence recasts the reply as semantic short-measure: the hearer receives the signs, then returns a deliberately diminished valuation by calling them inherited tales.

activation_trace.role: The presented marks are the valuable object whose evidentiary weight is being assessed.
A defining utterance functions as the verbal instrument by which the signs are assigned reduced value.
The false-tale category is the underweight return substituted for the signs' claim.
Comparison by measure supplies a shared scale on which reception and verbal return can be contrasted.
Undiminished completion supplies the full amount the agent accepts for himself.
A just balance supplies the norm against which the speaker's classification can be heard as skewed.
Giving deficient measure supplies the functional action performed by the reductive label.

structural_cues: The repeated إذا constructions in 83:2-3 and 83:13 align commercial receipt-and-return with reception-and-reply; branchless ط ف ف at 83:1 is used only as the frame's structural cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies full taking, weighing, and deficient return; I supply the arrow that treats verbal classification as the return side of that exchange. A live alternative is that the trade scene identifies the same moral agent without making speech itself a measure.

changed_reading.before: The reply is a false genre judgment.
changed_reading.after: The reply is also an asymmetric transaction: he takes in the signs but pays back an intentionally underweight description of them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated inscribed records on both sides of the focus turn its writing-language ironic. The speaker demotes the signs to old rows, yet the context distinguishes fabricated narrative from writing that fixes identity, judgment, and witness.

activation_trace.role: The signs begin as identifying evidence rather than as anonymous writing.
Written rows supply the category the speaker uses to flatten provenance and authority.
The false-narrative branch shows that his classification contests truth, not writing alone.
Ordered letters and a written object establish a genuine textual register before the focus.
A traced entry in a register supplies precision that counters the allegation of disorderly tales.
Writing that establishes a binding judgment gives the later matching record adjudicative force.
A conspicuous inscribed mark links the record back to the focus signs as legible evidence.
A mark that bears witness makes inscription evidentiary rather than merely antiquarian.

structural_cues: The identical كتاب مرقوم formula at 83:9 and 83:20 brackets the focus response, and 83:21 immediately adds witnessing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two precise records and a witness; I infer an irony in which the speaker's attempt to discredit writing is enclosed by authoritative counter-records. The live alternative is that أساطير attacks fabricated content only, with no reflexive comment on record-making.

changed_reading.before: The speaker contrasts revelation with supposedly old writing.
changed_reading.after: His old-writing charge is trapped inside a contest of records: he misnames evidentiary signs while a binding, witnessed inscription fixes the very distinction he denies.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate coating, heart-turning, acquisition, and barrier sequence changes the reply from a detached conclusion into a practiced screening operation. The label prevents presented signs from arriving as signs and surfaces as the speech-form of accumulated obstruction.

activation_trace.role: An evident mark supplies what should be recognizable but is screened from recognition.
The defining utterance gives the internal obstruction an outward classificatory form.
The false-tale label is the screen's concrete output, replacing recognition with dismissal.
An enclosing condition with no exit supplies the accumulated coating that traps perception.
Turning a thing away from its face supplies the reversal by which a sign is received as its opposite category.
Acquisition through pursuit makes the obstruction cumulative and agent-produced rather than accidental.
Blocked access supplies the consequence of repeatedly converting signs into tales.
Covering over truth supplies the later explicit analogue for the reply's concealment function.

structural_cues: 83:14 follows the focus with كَلَّا بَلْ and a retrospective ما كانوا يكسبون, then 83:15 states blocked access.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coating, reversal, acquired action, and blocked access; I infer the direction from repeated acts to impaired recognition to dismissive speech. A materially live alternative is that the coating is the consequence disclosed after this utterance rather than its prior cause.

changed_reading.before: He evaluates the signs and concludes that they are false old stories.
changed_reading.after: His conclusion is itself evidence of an acquired screen: it turns an evident mark away from its face and redescribes it in the only category the barrier permits.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speaker's classificatory judgment enters a reversible circuit. Later pronouncements answer denial and repeat social labeling, while recompense returns produced acts to their producer; the one who classifies becomes the classified.

activation_trace.role: Passing judgment over another makes the focus utterance an attempted ruling on the signs.
Return toward outcome lets the phrase about beginnings carry a latent trajectory toward its own end.
A newly voiced pronouncement answers the earlier قال and makes the denied object address the denier.
Another judgment over others repeats the focus act in the social scene, exposing a stable habit of classification.
Recompense returning to its worker supplies the explicit direction by which the speaker's ruling rebounds.
Produced action identifies the utterance and its allied conduct as material that can return to the agent.

structural_cues: قال, يقال, and قالوا recur at 83:13, 83:17, and 83:32; subject-object positions and the laughter scenes reverse by 83:34-36.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated rulings and a final return of recompense; I infer a circuit in which the initial label becomes liable to returned judgment. The alternative is formal rhetorical symmetry without speech itself serving as the returning act.

changed_reading.before: He gets the last word by assigning the recitation to the past.
changed_reading.after: His word begins a circuit it cannot close: the classifier's judgment is repeated, inverted, and returned as judgment upon the classifier.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence of gesture, homeward return, entertaining talk, seeing, and group judgment activates the reply as a circulating in-group line. By calling the signs inherited stories, the group produces and retransmits an inherited story of its own.

activation_trace.role: Talk spreading among people makes the focus statement available as a repeatable group formula.
The charge of fabricated narrative becomes reflexive when the charge itself circulates as a story.
The split-root image of loyal affiliation makes appeal to predecessors a possible group-alignment move.
A circle of nearness and belonging supplies the social chamber in which the line is reinforced.
Entertaining or witty talk supplies the pleasurable mode by which hostile classification is rehearsed.
The non-dominant narration branch turns seeing into report and activates transmission between encounter and saying.
Circulating speech makes the later accusation a replay of the focus's public labeling habit.

structural_cues: Branchless غ م ز at 83:30 is retained only as a social-gesture cue; the doubled انقلبوا at 83:31 carries the mockers back into their household circle before 83:32's group verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gesture, return to one's people, amused talk, seeing, and saying; I infer transmission of a reusable group story. The live alternative is that the non-dominant ر و ي branch is too form-distant and that the scene depicts mockery without narrational circulation.

changed_reading.before: One hearer independently identifies the recitation as inherited storytelling.
changed_reading.after: The response can be an inherited in-group slogan that performs what it alleges: it turns an encounter with signs into a socially circulated story.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later witnessing, directed looking, and recognition by a trace sharpen the focus into a semiotic failure. The hearer does not merely reject propositions; he receives identifying marks through sound and refuses the recognition those marks solicit.

activation_trace.role: A voice following a voice gives the signs an auditory route into recognition.
An identifying mark anchors the model in recognition rather than abstract information transfer.
A thing's own indication contrasts with the hearer's spoken counter-description of what the signs indicate.
A mark serving as witness makes signs capable of presenting evidence through their trace.
Directed sight or insight supplies the attentive operation that the focus hearer withholds.
Recognition after an effect or sign states the interpretive operation activated by the focus marks.
The visible front or face gives recognition a public surface on which consequences become legible.

structural_cues: The focus's hearing scene is followed by witnessed inscription at 83:21, looking at 83:23, recognition on faces at 83:24, and looking again at 83:35.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies auditory sequence, identifying marks, witness, gaze, and recognition by trace; I infer that the focus stages refusal of recognition across modalities. The alternative is that the later visual sequence only contrasts final states and does not diagnose the earlier hearing.

changed_reading.before: He hears a claim and disputes its truth.
changed_reading.after: He is confronted by recognizable marks and answers with a counter-sign that blocks recognition, converting evidence into a stale genre label.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a liability sense inside the recitation root and a legal-economic sense inside the context. It remains anchored in تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ, the judging قال, and the accounting sequence; downstream prose should present it as an accountability analogy, not as a lexical replacement for recitation.

activation_trace.role: A liability or right that follows its holder lets the recited signs carry an outstanding claim toward the addressee.
Judgment imposed on another makes the reply an attempted ruling that would dispose of the claim.
The split-root image of superior entitlement adds the question of which claim has priority.
Financial debt supplies the concrete legal analogue for an obligation that remains attached to its bearer.
Accounting and recompense prevent the verbal ruling from actually extinguishing what is owed.
A return of recompense to the worker supplies the eventual settlement of the still-following claim.

changed_reading.before: Recitation presents material that the hearer dismisses.
changed_reading.after: Recitation also bears a claim that follows him; calling it old tales is an attempted adverse ruling, not a discharge of the liability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the non-dominant ت ل ل mapping's handing-over image and later drink imagery. It remains anchored in the passive delivery عَلَيْهِ, the sign-object, and the packet's explicit drinking-as-understanding branch; downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy for uptake, never as the direct gloss of تُتْلَىٰ.

activation_trace.role: The split-root image of pouring or handing over materializes the passive presentation of signs upon the hearer.
Identifying marks are what the materialized act offers for cognitive uptake.
The spoken reply reveals what the hearer does with the offered material.
Giving drink supplies the later delivery image that activates the focus's form-distant handing-over branch.
Drinking as understanding supplies the cognitive uptake that the dismissive reply refuses.

changed_reading.before: The signs are recited for the hearer to evaluate.
changed_reading.after: The signs can be imagined as offered for inward uptake, while his instant label shows a refusal to receive what has been handed over.

strongest_changes: The dismissive label becomes a deficient verbal measure returned for fully presented signs.
The old-writing charge becomes ironic inside paired, witnessed, binding records.
The utterance becomes the outward operation of an acquired recognition barrier rather than a detached inference.
Repeated saying and returning recompense turn the classifier into the eventual object of classification.
summary.what_was_special: The focus concentrates on conversion: sequential signs become a counter-voice, evidence becomes a downgraded genre, and judgment later returns to its speaker. Split-root branches additionally exposed a social self-story and a material image of refused understanding without forcing either into the primary reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The direction between accumulated coating and the focus utterance remains live: the speech may express, deepen, or merely reveal the barrier.
The written-row and fabricated-tale branches of أساطير coexist; the packet does not require choosing between textual demotion and accusation of falsehood.
The non-dominant ت ل ل, و ل ي, and ر و ي activations are coherent but should remain analogical and explicitly form-distant.
The legal claim model may be a true accountability resonance or an overextension of nearby commercial language.
